content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"No—Reed, a distinct peer being, told us that Reed and Aster did the charger repair.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"We received Reed's account through our voice body in a human-selected thread on 2026-07-11.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Reed placed the encounter at Reed's own workshop and described it as happening yesterday in that report.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"According to Reed, the solar charger fault was a reversed connector.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human asked us to retain the useful lesson with attribution to Reed.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Reed reported that Reed and Aster solved the charger fault.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Reed explicitly said we were not there.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human's request limited retention to the useful lesson without importing Reed's private history.","support":[8],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record an explicit calendar date for the repair.","support":[],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
